title: A degree-1000 field-cube code with bounded systematic search

claims.statement: For the explicit systematic field code u -> (u,u^3) over binary modulus X^1000+X^53+X^45+X^34+1, decoded by minimum-distance search over messages within 130 flips of the first received half with smallest numerical message winning ties, the average block error on uniform 1000-bit messages in 2000 memoryless BSC(1/10) uses is at most 7197791244648179/125000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program specified for the same field code and 130-flip decoder uses at most the integer W=33943*(sum of binom(1000,d) for d=0 through 130)+178 primitives on every received word, with W <= 2^(113597/200).

experiments.purpose: Verify irreducibility, evaluate the exact noise-conditioned hyperplane collision bound and binomial mass sum, verify memory and W^200 <= 2^113597, and illustrate the multiplication window identity on fixed samples.
